name: CoE Lab — RBAC Datatable
description: Hand-authored gold architecture for Spring @PreAuthorize RBAC: service-layer DatatableWriteService (no HTTP) and AccountReadController (HTTP + RBAC).

nodes.name: DatatableWriteService
nodes.description: Authorization-enforcing service interface with @PreAuthorize on every method and no HTTP surface (a reference Java/JAX-RS banking platform-shaped).

security-rbac-001.description: Role-Based Access Control via Spring @PreAuthorize on create/update/delete datatable operations.

nodes.name: Account Read API
nodes.description: Spring REST controller at /accounts with method-level @PreAuthorize ACCOUNT_READ.

security-rbac-001.description: Role-Based Access Control via Spring @PreAuthorize hasAuthority ACCOUNT_READ on list and get.
